question: Trachoma is a preventable disease that results from poor hygiene and sanitation. Which of the following body parts does it affect?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Eye.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Trachoma is a preventable disease that results from poor hygiene and sanitation.
 
• Trachoma is a disease of the **eye**__ caused by the Chlamydia trachomatis bacteria.
 
• Trachoma causes **irreversible blindness.**
 
• It is a public health issue in 44 nations, causing around 1.9 million individuals to become blind or visually impaired.
 
• 137 million people live in trachoma-endemic areas and are in danger of trachoma blindness, according to data from March 2020.
 
• The infection is spread through infected people's eye and nose discharges, which can be transmitted directly or indirectly.
 
• Trachoma causes about** 1.4% of all blindness worldwide.**
 
• Through an innovative, multi-faceted public health strategy known as **S.A.F.E**, the World Health Organization has set a goal of eliminating trachoma by 2020.
 
• Cataract also affects the human eyes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Carditis is a disease that affects the human **Heart.**
 
• Gastritis is a disease that affects the **Stomach.**
 
• Otitis is a disease that affects the **Ear.**
